description: WP-O6 Codex: Orks (11e) PULSA ROKKIT (Tankbustas wargear, once per battle) through the real unit_selected_to_shoot window. Fixture ork11e_ab_shoot: the Tankbustas carry the Pulsa Rokkit (the fixture adds the wargear ability — the generated roster has no wargear picks), the Contemptor-Achillus and Telemon (VEHICLES) stand within 24". A real click on the Tankbustas opens the window; 'Use on Tankbustas' opens the unit picker listing only enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE units within 24"; a real click on the Contemptor marks it. The live attack hook then gives the Tankbustas +1 AP and [LETHAL HITS] against the Contemptor only; the rokkits fire at it (dispatched) without errors.
